title: Cooking and maker classes in Tampines
summary: The maker-lab (MakeIT) and other hands-on classes the National Library Board lists at Tampines Regional Library, and the cooking and baking classes the People's Association lists on onePA at the Tampines community clubs, from a dated snapshot of both public listings: a calendar and a list filtered by kind, organiser (NLB or onePA), venue, dates, free or paid and audience, each class with its time, length, room, ages, fees, places left as the source showed them and a Book on NLB or Book on onePA link to its official page. Past classes are hidden by default; refresh.py regenerates the snapshot.
